{{quotation|[[Master Dungeon Guide]]|Raven's Point, home of the Shrine of the Raven, is protected by the family of our good friend, Olaf. Communing at the shrine grants adventurers the powers of the raven spirit. King Jalis, thankful for Olaf's hospitality when the Deldrimor Dwarves first arrived in the Far Shiverpeaks, sent a group of Dwarves and a clever Asura to protect the hallowed place from Destroyers. After seeing firsthand the devastation these creatures had wrought, we didn't think twice about coming to their aid.}}

==Notes==
*If you do not have the required quest, the closed door by the [[Inscribed Stone]] will not let you leave the first room.
*Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #8 of the [[Master Dungeon Guide]] [[storybook]].
*Be careful of the ice traps.
;Level 1
*East from the Dungeon Key, a lone Ancient Vaettir roams at the end of the corridor. When approached, it will "push" three [[ice boulder]]s that roll down and kill any creature in their path.
**Allies such as minions and Dwarven Heroes will attempt to attack these boulders and may die as a result.
**The Vaettir may also die to these boulders.
;Level 2
*Light the braziers near the north bridge to lower the bridges.
*To get the dungeon key to drop, you must kill the [[Reaper of Destruction]] and the group of hidden destroyers at the Reaper's initial location.
*Near the portal to Level 3, the [[Chromatic Drake]]s and the [[Destroyer]]s will fight against each other.
;Level 3
*There is an area beyond the traps that is not shown on the map. There is nothing of value.
{{anomaly|There appears to be an unreachable area beyond the south west corner of level 2 which does not appear on the minimap, within which a Whirling Wisp may occasionally be seen.}}
{{bug|The final Destroyers may be friendly, making the dungeon impossible to complete.}}

==Trivia==
*There is a mural depicting a [[Word of Madness]] on the first level behind the northernmost [[resurrection shrine]].
